messages:
marta: Quick async check on the kernel + KV sprint — want a short ownership/deps snapshot. Milestone: stabilize continuous batching + KV warmup before next deploy. Proposed owners: @kevin (kernel microbatch), @dina (KV warmup/eviction), @sam (perf harness + rollback rules). Any blockers or missing deps?

kevin: I landed the microbatch change on staging, doing a canary run now. Seeing ~3-5% p50 improvement so far. Need to tune token-level lock contended path. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4321

dina: KV warmup PR is green locally but flaky in CI for long-seq profiles. Repro steps in the PR comments. Thinking to skip the flaky test for the short term and capture a follow-up issue for the validation harness. @sam can you run the longseq profile against staging when you have a moment?

sam: Triggered adhoc perf run with longseq profile at 2951236000. Also kicked off nightly with the same workload. Need the kernel docker tag from @kevin to match the canary image for parity.

kevin: Kernel tag is runtime-canary:2026-03-17-rc3. Use that for perf runs. I'll also run the kernel+quant combo test — @jeff flagged quant reorder might affect op scheduling.

jeff: Quant PR is queued for review, I can get it through today EOD. Heads-up: some op fusion ordering changed, so we should validate latencies on both short and long sequences. Ping me if the staging combo fails.

infra-bot: Canary deploy started at 2951236000 — 4 nodes allocated, 80GB RAM each, autoscaler: paused for canary. Logs: /canary/2951236000/logs

sam: Perf note: if p99 + tail latency increases >30% after combo deploy, we auto-rollback. I'll monitor dashboards and set an alert for +20% as an early warning.

marta: OK. Short action list:
- @kevin: verify kernel+quant combo on staging and post results (ETA: EOD today)
- @dina: push fix/skip for flaky longseq test + file follow-up issue (ETA: tomorrow)
- @sam: run perf harness with runtime-canary:2026-03-17-rc3 and longseq profile, watch p50/p99 (ETA: overnight)
- @jeff: finish quant PR review (ETA: EOD)
- @infra-bot: keep canary pinned, report any node anomalies.

marta: If everyone can reply with an ack or short status update when done, I'll compile and update the sprint board. Thanks :thumbsup:
